title: The Outdoor Chums in the Big Woods; Or, Rival Hunters of Lumber Run

This story follows four boys—Frank, Bluff, Jerry, and Will—as they embark on an exciting trip to a logging camp in Maine during winter. As they prepare for their journey, we are introduced to their personalities, outlining Frank as the leader and planner, Bluff as the enthusiastic hunter, Jerry as the supportive friend, and Will with his passion for photography.
